question: Which authoritative JSON persistence and allocation architecture should govern the Task control family before its schema, fixtures, and deterministic full-page documentation projection are defined?

options.summary: Chain-owned aggregate — embed each complete authoritative Task record in its one owning chain JSON.
options.consequence: The chain aggregate owns complete Task data and separate hierarchy, prerequisite, sequence, active-task, and activation relations. Proceed only to bounded contract definition; do not implement or activate a successor.

options.summary: Central catalog — store all complete authoritative Task records in one JSON Task catalog referenced by chains.
options.consequence: The catalog owns Task-local data, hierarchy, and prerequisites; chains own sequence and activation. Proceed only to bounded contract definition and cross-record invariants.

options.summary: File per Task — store each complete authoritative Task record in its own JSON file referenced by chains.
options.consequence: Each Task file owns Task-local data, hierarchy, and prerequisites; chains own sequence and activation. Proceed only to bounded contract definition and cross-record invariants.
Retain the Markdown bootstrap and current chain boundary. Do not define a Task schema, create fixtures, implement rendering, or generate a reference page.

recommendation: Option C — one authoritative JSON file per Task referenced by chains. It provides the strongest Task-local authority, bounded inspection and context, Git-diff locality, and failure isolation while preserving explicit chain-owned sequence and activation relations and the existing TaskReference record-path boundary.
blocked_scope: Architecture selection by an agent; Task field/schema authoring; fixtures; Python implementation; serializer or renderer implementation; generated-page work; Markdown-to-JSON cutover; successor activation; SQLite or event-log work; scientific, protected-execution, publication, or release authority.
safe_scope: Human review of Options A through D and the decision document at .pi/evidence/docs-json/task-json-authority-architecture.md. Deterministic validation and persistence of this pending decision boundary are permitted.
resumption_status: awaiting_human_task_json_authority_selection; no schema or implementation work authorized
